# WP899 optional actual registry association — Root design contract

Baseline eb0246c790b35865c1691644f1365d113e4ccae6. Slug-native cfgtest-only
nonsemantic diagnostic. This selects implementation design, not a new actual-root
invocation. Prior global1–5 freezes remain spent. Full source-fit/40GB/wholeWP899
remain open. User workload clarification is pending; independent work continues.

Adopt proposal registry-request-association-design-proposal.md SHA6104ac7252071c6a4e752eeb023eba3eadba817ba49d9ec1300a75dbda471204
and input audit SHA5e75854ff2e57b3d0464e668ddc483e60c046cb13a67829048ddbca8f1191cea,
with the refinements below. Independent DESIGN remains required before edits.

Natural ownership: both ScopedRegistryIo charge entrypoints and the consumed
SourceServiceScope. No DICE key/value/equality, transport error payload, HTTP
implementation, semantic cache, request normalization or registry/source policy
changes. Optional cfgtest association is armed once through existing inspect_for_test
before command; the harness pins its Arc and scope stores only Weak. The handle's
storage precedes its SourceBufferReservation, avoiding a strong reference cycle.
Weak upgrades and synchronous association->scope-state locks end before IO/await;
no locking across DICE. Factor original charge body once into a locked helper,
without altering checks, first poison, no-refund arithmetic, counters or return.

Exact association uses immutable scope workspace + route kind + literal full URL,
and the actual supplied OS path for Local. Fixed128 rows and precharged2MiB slab
with checked header/row/Arc overhead, URL<=8192/path<=8192, no new129th allocation.
Preserve ordinary charge before URL transport validation. Unsupported instrumentation
identity follows the existing source/IO path, marks evidence incomplete and cannot
certify unique counts or later first-rejection distinctness. Missing/gapped charge
coverage similarly prohibits exact certification. Scalar overflow marks incomplete;
never replace the returned primary transport/scope error. Scope constructor/API
limits128/16MiB/27+3 remain unchanged. Allocation or bank failure while arming
refuses the diagnostic before command and releases temporary storage/credit.
Recorder's real same-bank memory/highwater remains measured, not subtracted.
No fit assumption from the prior9.96MiB highwater.

Within the same original charge lock, distinguish this call creating the first
Limit(RegistryAttempts) from later sticky propagation; never infer creation from
an equal error seen later. Retain exact accepted distinct/repeat counts and bounded
per-row admission counts. For the first creator, compare borrowed request to all
complete existing rows without cloning it. Record ExistingRow ordinal/prior count
or NewDistinctUnretained unique ordinal=distinct+1. Call ordinal=129 is a separate
domain and must not be substituted for a row ordinal. Later sticky calls do not
replace first origin. Generic/unobserved prior registry charges mark coverage
incomplete. No raw URL/path/environment/credential/hash/length vectors are emitted.

Receipt may pair the recorded first exhaustion with selected typed Scope Limit
only after proving the actual fresh diagnostic engine uses this one installed
scope, complete association and exact first poison+selected counter. Same error
Eq alone is insufficient. This supports causal first exhaustion, not identity of
the selected leaf's own call (a later concurrent caller can see sticky poison).
That stronger selected-leaf identity stays unproved. Snapshot after normal
restoration and worker drain, while handle alive; then drop recorder before
existing scope Weak/lastDrop controls. Engine retirement remains separately real.
No provisional snapshot is labeled settled/exact.

Implementation allowlist: Core runtime/source_service.rs private cfgtest registration;
source_service/{scope,registry}.rs narrow charge/attachment glue; new cohesive
source_service/registry_association.rs and registry_association/tests.rs; Root
source_preparation/{genuine_root,refusal_receipt}.rs finite redacted observation;
source_service/diagnostic_tests.rs only genuine fixture reuse/lifecycle control.
No diagnostic constructor change. Source scope helper estimate180–260 lines plus
200–300 tests; Root glue <=100 lines. Inspect final growth/responsibilities rather
than copy existing large fixture families. No donor data structure/new interner.

Gates: unarmed old results/counters/zero association credit; exact repeated and
same-URL/different-local-path identities/nonUTF8;128 admissions then actual rejected
129th repeated/distinct with no storage/counter/body/open progression; concurrent
charge ordering/firstcreator vs sticky selectedcaller; exact8192/one-over incomplete
handling; precharge pressure/failed arm/latearm/no cycle/clone lastDrop. A real
owned local source must positively demonstrate source-open observation before its
refused sentinel; no purely mock completed graph. Reuse normal graph fixture and
natural selected-owner diagnostic restoration/engine/cause controls for coupled
proof; do not create a new semantic observer. Compile60s separately, preflight all
selected ordinary selectors, execute serial bounded30s. Default direct-dependent
compile covers narrow non-test charge factoring. Independent FINAL against final
sources and actual evidence before any separately contracted actual observation.

design_proposal.text:
# DESIGN proposal: exact diagnostic registry-request association

WP899 / HEAD1329ca995. Source-only proposal; no implementation, executions, acquisition or new actual-root authorization. Preserve128 RegistryAttempts,27+3+3 clocks, all source policy/transport/semantic behavior and source/buffer limits. The purpose is to distinguish exact admitted repeats from distinct natural RegistryIo invocations, not to promote source facts or claim unique HTTP requests.

## Chosen owner and API

Use optional **Core cfg(test) only**, consumed-scope-local association at the existing scoped registry charge boundary (registry.rs109/141). Keep normal DICE keys/cache/errors unchanged. A generic RegistryIo decorator is smaller textually but cannot atomically identify the first limit-producing request under concurrent calls; it would need serialization across await or could associate the wrong call. Neither is acceptable. HTTP leaf does not charge RegistryAttempts; no instrumentation there or duplicate HTTP implementation.

Proposed private child `runtime/source_service/registry_association.rs` (+private tests), cfgtest registration/reexport in source_service.rs; narrow cfgtest glue in scope.rs and registry.rs; genuine_root.rs owned by Root for numeric emission only. Existing diagnostic.rs/constructor need no new seam: before `prepare_once_observed`, call existing `inspect_for_test` to arm the scope and retain the returned handle. Exact proposed names:

```rust
// Core-private, cfg(test), no public semantic API.
enum RegistryRequestRef<'a> { Url(&'a RegistryFileUrl), Local { url: &'a RegistryFileUrl, path: &'a Path } }
struct RegistryRequestAssociation; // opaque, no Debug exposing storage
struct RegistryAssociationSnapshot; // Copy; fixed numeric fields only
impl SourceServiceScope {
    fn arm_registry_association_for_test(self: &Arc<Self>)
        -> Result<Arc<RegistryRequestAssociation>, SourceServiceError>;
    fn charge_registry_request_for_test(&self, request: RegistryRequestRef<'_>)
        -> Result<(), SourceServiceError>;
}
impl RegistryRequestAssociation {
    fn snapshot(&self) -> RegistryAssociationSnapshot;
}
```

Unarmed cfgtest method delegates exactly `charge(RegistryAttempts,1)`. Non-test registry code retains that existing call. Armed method upgrades a cfgtest-only `OnceLock<Weak<RegistryRequestAssociation>>`, then holds association lock→scope-state lock for one synchronous bounded compare/check/increment/record. Refactor the existing charge body into a private locked helper if needed; one ordinary charge implementation, unchanged return value/first poison/commit semantics. No lock across URL parse, IO, await or DICE. No attach mutation/rearm after command entry; arm once in exclusive precommand state, require attempts0/no poison/open. Missing/dropped handle marks association unavailable, never fabricates a complete snapshot. Snapshot only after transaction drop/drain/actual restoration, before dropping the handle.

**Ownership cycle prohibition:** SourceBufferReservation contains Arc<Scope>. Never put a strong association containing that reservation in ScopeState. The harness owns the association Arc; scope holds Weak only. Association fields place owned storage before its reservation, which pins the actual existing16MiB bank. Temporary adapter upgrades live only during charge, never across await. Drop harness association after taking fixed snapshot and before ScopeWeak/lastDrop assertions; it is an intentional additional scope pin. Failed initialization drops storage before credit and retains no attachment. No actor/global/thread-local registry or semantic interner.

## Exact request relation and finite storage

Workspace is the actual immutable scope workspace, checked once when arming and retained by its existing owner. Identity is **full** literal URL bytes, route kind, and for `read_local_exact`, actual supplied Path OS bytes (Linux nonUTF8 preserved); scope equality supplies the workspace component. No URL/path normalization, hashes, string parsing of errors, guessed resolved location or URI equivalence. `read_exact` URL alone determines its selected parsed file path; it is not falsely equated with the Local supplied-path route. The Local override does not call Url route. Immutable copies only for newly admitted distinct identities; repeated calls compare borrowed incoming bytes against recorded rows. Record rows in first-admission order with counts; at most128 owned distinct requests.

Precharge a fixed slab for128*(8192 URL bytes+8192 optional local-path bytes), fixed128 row metadata and headers (checked size_of arithmetic) against the existing bank **before** allocation. One checked-capacity Vec/slab and fixed row array avoid per-row growth/copy replacement/interner overhead. URL/local bytes copied only after full bounds and the normal charge admission; no owned129th request. Exact linear comparison is bounded by128 rows; worst admission sequence O(128²*16384) byte comparisons, finite but can perturb timing. Slab2MiB plus rows/headers stays live until handleDrop, adds real RSS and same-bank highwater, reduces available16MiB service capacity and may cause earlier operational BufferLimit. Existing9961961B measured peak is not a guarantee of fit with this recorder. Do not increase any cap or subtract the recorder from measured peak. Receipt exposes actual association charged bytes/highwater and complete/missing status. Precharge failure is an honest operational diagnostic failure; no retry.

Address>8192 is already unsupported at scoped Url entrypoint AFTER charge. Local path currently has no such diagnostic length bound. To avoid silently adding source admission semantics, an oversized identity should preserve the ordinary charge/error/IO path, set association_complete=0, count unassociated admitted/refused calls, and never publish exact unique counts. Do not reject the source merely to fit instrumentation. This rule also applies to initialization/unavailable storage if Root chooses a non-failing arming API; either choice must be frozen explicitly. Recommended arming allocation failure refuses the diagnostic before command, while unsupported per-call identity makes evidence incomplete without changing transport behavior.

## Charge/first-poison association

Within the same charge critical section, separately count admitted entries, refused entries, admitted distinct identities/repeats, and sticky refusals. Keep ordinary counters unchanged: a limit-producing further+1 leaves registry_attempts128. Capture **only the first limit creator**, with request relation `ExistingRow{ordinal, prior_admitted_count}` or `NewDistinctUnretained{ordinal:129}` established by full comparison of the borrowed incoming request against every recorded row. No owned clone is needed for the new129th identity. This is a one-time exact distinctness classification; after its bytes are gone it is NOT a retained comparable request or source capability. Later sticky refusals may increment finite counters but do not replace first creator or spend memory on further request identities. Other initial poison/ordinary precharging/unsupported identity leaves creator association explicitly missing. Checked diagnostic scalar overflow marks incomplete rather than changing the primary transport error.

Receipt can report admitted_distinct/repeated, refused_entries, first_limit_relation/ordinal/prior_admitted_count, sticky_refused_entries, retained_row_count<=128, observation_complete and credit bytes. No raw URL, actual local path, source/env/credential content or digest, request-length vectors, per-row payload, exception Debug, or path-derived labels are emitted.

**Selected-error pairing has a precise limitation.** Existing selected SourceSelection carries the actual copied typed Scope LimitRegistryAttempts, and Scope preserves its first poison. At final observation verify exact same scope, first_error==LimitRegistryAttempts, actual selected cause==that fixed limit, and creator association complete. Then assert paired_first_limit_origin=1. This associates the causal first exhaustion request with the chosen sticky error; it does **not** identify the selected RegistryFile leaf's own URL/call ordinal, which may be a later concurrent caller returning the same poison. Existing public RegistryTransportError/cause payload has no call token. Proving that different stronger relationship would require a reviewed cross-crate retained typed field/propagation change; a Core cfgtest side map or matching errors by Eq cannot supply it. Recommended next contract needs first-exhaustion cause + admitted distinct/repeat counts, leaving selected-leaf identity explicitly unproved. Root must confirm that suffices before implementation.

## Required bounded discriminators

1. Unarmed path keeps old counters/results/errors and no additional bank charge; ordinary None/runtime unchanged.
2. Real scoped Local adapter calls: same full URL+path repeated→one exact row/two admitted entries; same URL/different actual path→two rows; different URL/same file→distinct; raw nonUTF8 path preserved. Positive real source-read control and blocked+1 control prove no IO/body/buffer allocation after rejection.
3.128 admitted calls then129th repeated existing row versus129th distinct borrowed identity: counter stays128, exact relation/counts, no129th storage, first poison typed/counter correct. Later cleanup/cancel/sticky call cannot overwrite creator.
4. Concurrent barrier-controlled natural charges: admission/creator ordering follows the actual charge lock, successful byte consumption can finish in another order, no awaitlock; selected later sticky cause is not mislabeled its own identity.
5. Exact8192/one-over URL and local OS-byte identity: complete evidence only in bound; unsupported evidence never changes ordinary transport admission/error. Precharge pressure, failed initialization, clone pins/owner-before-creditDrop and post-drain strict retirement; no cycle.
6. Existing genuine normal diamond fixture, not completed-result injection: shared child one adapter call; genuine generation change repeats exact identity and exposes count; controlled normal failure→Core downcast pairs first limit origin, restoration and engineDrop. Reuse old snapshot/reader/primary tests. No new actual-root attempt from portable gates alone.

Estimate ~180–260 cohesive cfgtest production lines plus ~200–300 fixture lines; exact whole-bank/cycle/lock requirements warrant review if growth increases. All source files named above need manifest authorization and independent DESIGN before edits. Remaining decision is explicit acceptance of first-limit-origin association rather than stronger selected-leaf identity, and freeze of evidence-incomplete handling for unsupported Local bytes. No cap growth, semantic dedup, request retry, actual-root launch, or40GB/full-fit conclusion follows.

input_design_audit.text:
# Registry request association — input/ownership audit

Source-only at HEAD1329ca995. Proposal inspected: `target/wp899/registry-request-association-design-proposal.md`, SHA6104ac7252071c6a4e752eeb023eba3eadba817ba49d9ec1300a75dbda471204. No implementation/execution/acquisition/cap change or actual-root retry. Root's counting-test compile is independent.

## Finding

The proposed optional cfg(test) scope-local association is coherent for **exact admitted RegistryIo invocation identity counts and the first exhaustion origin**. It does not prove the selected RegistryFile error leaf's own invocation identity, unique HTTP connections, unique valid modules, or a duplicate-fetch defect. Preserve that weaker precise claim. No extra production key, source authority, DICE trace marker or strong Scope↔ledger cycle is required.

Two small precision corrections should enter the frozen contract before implementation:

1. Separate attempted-call ordinal (first failing increment is entry129 under this cap) from retained distinct-row index / first-admission ordinal. With repeats, a new distinct129th call may be only the second distinct request; never emit129 as a distinct-row identity. Use explicitly named finite scalar fields/codes.
2. An oversized/unassociated admitted identity makes the whole distinct/repeat and first-limit comparison incomplete. Even a later in-bound129th request cannot be certified NewDistinct against ALL prior admitted calls when some were not retained. Emit unavailable/unknown and complete0; any partial row statistics must be labelled partial. Unsupported instrumentation size must not alter the ordinary charge/transport/IO outcome. Apply the same rule to unavailable handle or diagnostic counter overflow. Keep original first poison and selected native error unchanged.

These are evidence completeness/field-meaning requirements, not an authorization to reject extra source operations or increase caps. Supervisor was messaged with both corrections.

## Actual source relation and coverage

- `source_service/registry.rs:102–132` `read_exact` charges RegistryAttempts BEFORE URL-length validation, parse or IO. Full literal URL identifies its Url route. A file URL is parsed then delegated directly to private read_local without another charge. Do not add a second association at that helper.
- `:135–145` `read_local_exact` charges once, then reads its actual supplied Path. Identity must include this route tag, full original RegistryFileUrl and the supplied OS path bytes (nonUTF8 preserved), not a rendered/normalized path. Same URL/different supplied path and different URL/same path are distinct natural inputs.
- Grep of live runtime finds only these two ordinary RegistryAttempts charge sites; remaining direct charges are existing cfgtest scope controls. No HTTP charge/retry instrumentation is needed. Both cfgtest replacements must delegate the same ordinary charge logic, not maintain competing counters.
- `scope.rs:130–177` fixes one actual normalized workspace and immutable deadlines/limits. `dice.rs:6097–6121` canonicalizes runtime workspace and checks exact scope workspace equality before installation. `registry_io::install_scoped` installs this same scope's adapter. The ledger may borrow the scope-owned workspace component; it need not clone a per-row workspace path. A different workspace/scope is a separate observation, never folded together.
- `scope.rs:231–255` checks sticky error/deadline/closed state and charge under its single state mutex; successful+1 increments, failed129 leaves128 and selects the first Limit. Recording the borrowed129th relation under that SAME charge critical section associates the actual exhaustion creator. A separate before/after observer lock would allow another concurrent caller to poison first and misassociate the identity.
- Fixed association→scope lock order is acceptable only for synchronous bounded copy/compare/check/record, with no IO/URL parse/await/DICE/alloc while locked. Scope code must never acquire association while already holding the state lock. The snapshot must be after actual transaction drop/cancellation drain/restoration so admitted/refused counts have settled; a concurrent snapshot is only a partial observation.

## Lifecycle and memory

`SourceBufferReservation` (scope.rs:358–370) retains Arc<Scope>. Proposed harness-owned Arc<Association> with storage declared before this reservation, and Scope holding ONLY OnceLock<Weak<Association>>, has no strong cycle. Scope attachment may upgrade only during a charge; no upgrade crosses async transport. Harness clones pin the recorder and its complete precharged storage; failed initialization leaves no attachment and releases storage before credit. Arm once before command/source work with attempts0/no poison/open, never rearm during the command.

The approximately2MiB fixed identity slab plus checked128-row/header capacities uses the ACTUAL existing16MiB service bank, precharged before allocation and held until association lastDrop. If allocator capacity exceeds the charged slab/header capacity, refuse evidence construction before publication rather than silently use spare memory. Exact literal comparisons avoid hash-only equality; at most128 rows and bounded16384 input bytes per row make retained memory and work finite. Count repeated calls without allocating duplicates, and do not own any129th identity. The new instrumentation can legitimately cause earlier BufferLimit or deadline failure; the prior9961961-byte peak does not prove new fit. Include its real reservation/live/peak and do not subtract it from normal accounting or claim lower memory/RSS.

Existing genuine_root::Observer stores Weak<Scope> (:280), samples counters/poison in after_restore (:375–378), and later requires actual engine/scope retirement. Arming/retaining a ledger intentionally adds a Scope pin through its reservation. Take only a Copy scalar snapshot after joined work, then DROP every ledger strong handle before the existing ScopeWeak/lastDrop checks; no returned receipt/certificate may retain it. No emitted URL/path/hash/credential/Debug/per-row length vector is allowed.

## What future evidence would and would not establish

If all128 admitted identities are captured exactly, `distinct + repeat == admitted ==128`, and the borrowed first-failing call is fully compared, an in-bound new relation proves at least129 distinct natural RegistryIo identities were attempted in this scope. An existing-row relation proves that call was a repeat of a specified retained row, with a bounded prior admission count. Sticky later callers cannot replace the first creator. Pairing with actual selected Scope::Limit(RegistryAttempts) and identical scope first poison proves selected sticky-cause origin, **not** that the selected leaf itself requested the first-exhaustion identity.

Repeated URLs can be legitimate across separate legacy/observed owner families, full observed-policy frontier invalidations, current generation changes, or failed acquisition recovery. Counts alone cannot classify them as a cache bug. The ordinary normal diamond/current/generation gates provide controlled semantics, not the actual-root closure. Different versions remain distinct literal URLs and must not be suppressed merely to fit128.

Minimum discriminators from the proposal are material: both actual adapter routes and nonUTF8 supplied path; exact+one-over identity bounds with transport unchanged;128/129 existing and new relations including prior repeats; concurrent first-creator/late sticky return; unknown prior identity prevents false NewDistinct; no IO after failed admission; bank pressure/allocation/clone-lastDrop and weak-cycle retirement; actual selected normal owner failure/restore pairing. No new source run follows automatically from these controls. Root must freeze first-origin versus stronger selected-leaf claim before authorization.

## Source pins / commands

- `app/slug_core_v2/src/runtime/source_service/registry.rs`: `014b040ca940d37d086f5ff6546dcabf5d18780fb6b16867c5ba345268d24515`.
- `app/slug_core_v2/src/runtime/source_service/scope.rs`: `a8a28481c79be7cbcb8492be1e98e247b196c00b5ae34c8b24ee8e0cef44f2a3`.
- `app/slug_core_v2/src/runtime/source_service/diagnostic.rs`: `ce1566cce9e7db2861745d7e133e4bd1678de1bade203da1a342a11630725be6`.
- `app/slug_core_v2/src/runtime/source_preparation/genuine_root.rs`: `c7cc4011733f05c01de68841e6dc1fb5295bc2a564b62ace867125da07cc0a90`.
- `app/slug_core_v2/src/runtime/dice.rs`: `30ea4f59c81e92150fff01417ebe896d5814ed8274c25dd148f079251622801a`.

Read-only sed/rg commands exit0, and the proposal's exact SHA was checked in this receipt. No ambient environment/home/config/credential reads. Sole write is this private audit receipt. Full WP899 actual source admission, process/runtime fit and historical40GB attribution remain unproved.

design_review.text:
# WP899 registry request association — independent DESIGN

**DESIGN ACCEPT the integrated Root contract**, SHA256 `3721c61dc1db3400eb902c7ab6eca340c77ea9f63b4ceb154af86df10e6785f1`, with the implementation precision requirements below. It reconciles proposal SHA256 `6104ac7252071c6a4e752eeb023eba3eadba817ba49d9ec1300a75dbda471204` and input ownership audit SHA256 `5e75854ff2e57b3d0464e668ddc483e60c046cb13a67829048ddbca8f1191cea`; current clean HEAD is `eb0246c790b35865c1691644f1365d113e4ccae6`. No implementation, tests, Cargo, actual source acquisition, network, configuration/environment reads or cleanup occurred. This freezes a diagnostic association owner, not an actual-root run, semantic repair, cap increase or whole WP899.

The outcome is explicitly **admitted RegistryIo identity counts plus the first registry-limit creator's request relation**. That is sufficient to distinguish admitted unique/repeated logical reads in this scope and the creator relation at exhaustion. It does not identify the chosen RegistryFile leaf's own request; a later concurrent leaf can return the same sticky limit. No discarded side trace/error-message/Eq match can strengthen that claim. The actual chosen typed limit, same scope first poison and complete creator observation may establish paired-first-limit-origin only, under the fresh diagnostic engine's sole installed scoped RegistryIo owner. A foreign engine/service, unrelated first poison or absent native cause keeps pairing unproved.

## Identity, ordinals and completeness

Identity is the actual fixed scope workspace plus route tag, full literal URL bytes and, for Local supplied-path reads, the original OS path bytes. Both natural entrypoints are instrumented exactly once; the private file helper and HTTP leaf are not charged again. No normalization, URI equivalence, semantic key/hash change, suppression or completed-result injection occurs.

**Call ordinal and distinct row ordinal are different fields.** At128 admitted charges the first limit-producing next charge is attempted entry129. If that request is a new identity after prior repeats, it may be only the second distinct identity. The integrated contract correctly separates `attempted_call_ordinal=129` from `NewDistinctUnretained`'s prospective unique ordinal `distinct+1`. The latter describes the proven borrowed identity's position in complete distinct history; it does not grant an owned/stored row or comparable retained identity after the call returns. ExistingRow records its actual first-admission row ordinal and prior admitted multiplicity separately. A hypothetical smaller test limit follows limit+1 rather than hardcoding129.

Any earlier unassociated admitted identity invalidates whole-history distinct/repeat completeness and any later NewDistinct comparison. Oversized URL/local path, unavailable handle, diagnostic scalar overflow or an identity gap yields explicit incomplete/unknown, never an exact new-row conclusion against only the retained subset. Partial row statistics must be labelled partial; exact distinct+repeat=admitted is published only when every admitted identity was retained. A fully matched existing row may be reported as an observed relation while whole-history completeness remains false, but must not be called complete first-origin proof. No instrumentation-bound failure changes ordinary charge/transport/IO outcomes. URL>8192 retains its original post-charge BufferLimit semantics; Local path>8192 does not acquire a new source rejection.

## Synchronization and lifecycle

Association lock→scope-state lock is one synchronous, bounded charge/compare/copy/record operation. Factor one ordinary locked charge helper; all unarmed/non-test paths keep its original check, checked increment, first poison, cancellation and last admitted count. Capture whether this call actually created the first registry limit while still holding the same state lock; returned Err alone cannot distinguish a creator from an earlier sticky refusal. Later sticky calls never replace that creator. No IO, URL parse, allocator growth, await or DICE computation occurs under either lock. Scope must never acquire association from an already-held state lock. Drop the scope-state guard before dropping a possibly last association Arc: its reservation Drop also locks the scope.

Arming is once, before command entry, with open/healthy scope and zero registry attempts. Allocate/precharge outside any recursively acquired scope lock, then revalidate and attach only after fully constructed storage. A concurrent charge/poison/close between checks rejects attachment, rather than silently treating a partially observed history as complete. OnceLock prevents late rearm/replacement. Failed initialization leaves no attachment and drops storage before credit; conservative allocation failure refuses the diagnostic before command. This differs from per-call oversized identities, which preserve source behavior and make evidence incomplete.

Scope stores only Weak<Association>; harness retains the strong handle. The association's owned slab/rows precede its actual SourceBufferReservation, so owner destruction precedes credit release and the reservation's Arc<Scope> creates no cycle. Precharge checked128-row/header/Arc/lock bookkeeping plus the fixed2MiB maximum byte slab before allocating; reported capacity beyond charged capacity is refused before publication. No per-row growth, duplicated repeated identity or owned failing129th request is needed. Scope workspace is already owned and immutable; per-row clones are unnecessary.

The added reservation stays in the same16MiB bank, contributes to real live/highwater/RSS and may cause earlier BufferLimit or deadline failure. Prior9,961,961-byte peak does not prove it fits. No ceiling increase, subtraction, measured-fit assumption or new allocation outside the stated owner is permitted. The bounded linear full-byte comparison has finite but observable cost; record timing without claiming negligible overhead.

Snapshot only after actual transaction drop, cancelled worker drain and restoration. It returns fixed Copy scalars, never URLs/paths/length vectors/digests/Debug/storage. Drop every ledger strong handle before existing ScopeWeak/clone/lastDrop gates; otherwise the credit intentionally pins the scope. Successful exported source views/receipts must not retain the ledger. Concurrent/live snapshots cannot claim settled exact totals.

## Discriminating implementation gates

Retain unarmed old counters/errors/no additional bank allocation. Exercise both real adapter routes, same URL+path repeats, changed supplied nonUTF8 path and different URL/same file identities, with genuine read control. At existing128 limit, test both repeated and new borrowed entry129 after prior repeated identities, no129th owned copy, counter remains128 and no source-open/read/body admission after rejection. Race controlled charge entrants so the actual lock winner is the creator and later sticky return cannot replace it; do not impose completion/network order.

Test exact8192/one-over identity bounds, prior unrecorded identity followed by an in-bound exhaustion request, dropped/unavailable handle, late/concurrent arming, checked diagnostic overflow and failed initialization. Show ordinary per-call source outcomes unchanged. Credit pressure/actual capacities, owner-before-credit destruction, shared handle pinning and strict post-drain zero retirement must prove no cycle. Finally use a genuine normally computed owner refusal and its actual Core downcast to pair first-origin with restoration/engine retirement; no hand-built complete owner certificate or selected-leaf identity assertion. Reuse unchanged normal graph/generation and lower lifecycle controls.

No smaller authoritative replacement was found: an async RegistryIo decorator can count calls but cannot atomically associate the first scope-limit creator under concurrency; serializing its await would change scheduling. A static lock address set cannot establish current actual demand, and hash-only instrumentation cannot give collision-free exact identity. The selected weak, bounded optional owner addresses the missing observation without production semantic keys or new authority. These portable gates alone authorize no actual-root retry; a later observation requires a new source-matched contract/freeze and still may terminate incomplete or earlier due instrumentation overhead.

final_review.text:
# Registry request association — independent FINAL

**FINAL ACCEPT this bounded component.** Reviewed against baseline `eb0246c790b35865c1691644f1365d113e4ccae6`, integrated contract SHA256 `3721c61dc1db3400eb902c7ab6eca340c77ea9f63b4ceb154af86df10e6785f1` and DESIGN receipt `731ee2764b1fbb6c7bfc7e28654a44f0d8fc8aa5abca7a7baca3de56eb395f1a`. No remaining material source or required component evidence gap found. This verdict covers the optional cfg(test, Linux) recorder and ordinary non-test charge factoring, not a new actual-root invocation or full WP899.

## Source invariants

`scope.rs:235–264` factors the original check/checked-add/maximum/first-poison/cancellation/counter-update body into one private locked helper. The non-test call holds the same state lock for the same operations. No source policy, limits, DICE keys/equality, transport error or normalization changes occur. Both actual ScopedRegistryIo entrypoints have exactly one instrumented charge before their old parse/source paths; direct file/HTTP helpers do not double-charge. `_url` to `url: _url` is a routine cfg(test) field binding correction, with the original signature retained.

The recorder owns fixed128 rows plus a fixed2MiB byte slab. `registry_association.rs:119–144` checks/precharges slab, fixed state/header/construction overlap before allocation, uses try_reserve_exact and refuses excess capacity before publication. Storage fields precede the scope-holding reservation.
